top_signals.title: ASX Shares Jump Most in Six Years After Upbeat Listings Outlook
top_signals.summary: ASX Ltd. shares capped their best day in six years after Australia’s main exchange operator gave a positive outlook on its listings business ahead of Anthony Attia’s arrival as the firm’s chief executive officer next month.
